purpose: Test whether the bounded fixed-horizon behavior admitted by Gate A is safely representable by the existing production transaction topology, without changing temporal tolerance, retry policy, solver policy, mass gates or coupling semantics.

held_out_matrix.reference_warning: Each N=512 trajectory is a finite same-endpoint reference, not an exact solution.

production_shape.temporal_acceptance: production binary temporal metric retained; observer instrumentation is test-only and must normalize back to the production backend

comparison_semantics.transaction_observable: For each actual retry attempt, record max_i abs(h_full-h_two_half) from the existing FULL/HALF1/HALF2 transaction topology.
comparison_semantics.same_endpoint_reference: For the identical committed T0 state, forcing and attempt endpoint, compare the two-half endpoint against an N=512 equal-substep trajectory over that same attempt horizon.
comparison_semantics.reason: This avoids comparing fixed-horizon refinement N with retry count. Both defect and finite-reference endpoint error refer to exactly the same physical endpoint time.

gate_questions: Do all 24 held-out cases reach all three production retry attempts without solver or mass rejection under unchanged controls?
Does transaction-observed D_h agree with the direct same-horizon N=1 versus N=2 defect?
At each actual retry attempt, is D_h conservative relative to the remaining two-half-to-N512 endpoint error where both are above the numerical floor?
If an outer attempt is conservative, do later retry halvings preserve rather than lose that property?
Can the existing retry topology therefore represent the Gate A bounded profile without a new owner/runtime policy?

decision_rule.PASS: All resolved held-out cases preserve a safe conservative estimator relationship through the actually reachable retry sequence, so Gate A can be translated without changing runtime policy.
decision_rule.FAIL_TRANSLATION: One or more resolved held-out cases lose or fail the conservative estimator relationship on an actually reachable retry. Return fail-closed to F-SI20 and require a separate owner/runtime policy decision. Do not tune a tolerance or retry budget inside F-VQ28.

not_allowed: F-GC02 release from Gate B alone
next_action: Implement the source-locked Gate B harness and run it exactly on this frozen matrix.
